llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple classic scam indicators: it mimics the branding and policies of a legitimate e-commerce platform (Lazada), advertises implausible discounts (-99%), and pushes urgency for users to download an app and make purchases. There's no valid company or contact information, only a generic 24/7 live chat, and the domain is newly registered (2025-07-02) with privacy-protected registrant data. All of these are clear signs of a fake online shopping scam.
